title: PtyExited
description:
`pty.exited`'s data, on the `pty` topic: the process ended. The PTY keeps its last
screen until `pty.kill`.

```json
{"pty_id": "6f1c2e0a9b8d4f3e2a1b0c9d8e7f6a5b", "status": 3}
```

error.description: Why rlxd ended the process itself, when it did, as [`PtyScreen`]'s says.

signal.description: The signal that ended it, when one did.
